message:
feat(dlss): add read-only three-frame color-evidence triage

Validate the existing per-frame oracle layout, PS c0-c10/c255 words,
producer/resolve/copy allocation and version chain, and frame continuity.
Report raw/decoded c10.x without inferring color or changing the renderer.
Register 13 synthetic parser/CLI tests through optional Python CTest.
Exit 0 means ready for manual color review, never P2 or GPU acceptance.
